title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the force required to keep the charge at rest.

title: Use of Image Charges
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the method of images to determine the image charges and their locations.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the boundary conditions correctly to relate the potentials in the two dielectric regions.

title: Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the expression for the force acting on the charge based on the contributions from all relevant charges.

title: Sign and Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the final expression for the force and ensure units are consistent.
